note: A motor retainer modelled as a mass component no longer blocks the motor: the "Max motor length" estimate treated any mass component in the mount as an obstruction, and on a real 4 inch Wildman Extreme - a 380 mm mount with a zero-length retainer 15 mm up from the aft end - it reported room for a 15.5 mm motor instead of 380.5 mm. Parachutes, streamers and shock cords do not block either; an engine block or a bulkhead still does. The 2D design canvas also stops shrinking by the full height of the All Stats drawer (measured 460 to 335 px on a 1080p window, a 27 % loss), the floating stats gadget stops sitting on the rocket, and it folds to its one-line pill while the drawer - which already shows all five of its numbers - is open.
